about: Four fictional internship postings (companies, places and roles are invented). Every requirement is a must-have and is written so that a resume either shows it or does not. `keywords` is the word list for the keyword baseline: a requirement counts as met when any of its words appears in the resume. The lists were fixed before any run.

jobs.title: Data Analyst Intern
jobs.summary: Harbourline moves parcels for online shops across Peninsular Malaysia. The intern joins the analytics team and helps the operations and sales teams understand delivery performance. Internship of 3 to 6 months, starting January 2027.

requirements.text: Currently enrolled in a bachelor's or master's degree programme (not yet graduated).
Has used SQL in a job, internship or project (described under experience or projects; a skills list alone does not count).
Has built at least one dashboard or interactive report (for example in Tableau, Power BI or Looker Studio). Static charts do not count.
Has at least 6 months of work or internship experience in total.
Available for at least 4 days a week for at least 3 months.
Has presented analysis results to a non-technical audience (for example managers or sales staff).

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Intern
jobs.summary: Larkspur runs 14 outpatient clinics in the Klang Valley. The intern supports the recruiting team with interviews, job postings and candidate records. Internship of 3 to 6 months, starting January 2027.

requirements.text: Currently studying human resources, business, psychology or a closely related field.
Has scheduled interviews, meetings or appointments with external people (for example candidates or study participants).
Has tracked candidates or applicants in an applicant tracking system (ATS) or a spreadsheet.
Has written job postings, recruitment posts or other public-facing copy.
Has handled confidential personal data under a privacy or confidentiality rule.
Available for at least 4 days a week.

jobs.title: 数据运营实习生
jobs.summary: 云栈网络做本地生活类小程序。实习生加入运营团队，负责用户和内容数据的日常分析，支持活动复盘。实习 3 到 6 个月，2027 年 1 月起。

requirements.text: 本科或硕士在读（尚未毕业）。
在实习或项目中用 Excel 数据透视表或 SQL 做过数据分析（只写在“技能”栏里不算）。
有至少一段内容运营或用户运营方向的实习经历。
实习经历累计不少于 3 个月。
每周可实习 4 天及以上，并能持续 3 个月以上。
做过 A/B 测试或活动效果复盘。

jobs.title: 招聘助理实习生
jobs.summary: 橙果教育在西南地区有 30 多个校区。实习生协助招聘团队安排面试、发布招聘信息、管理候选人资料。实习 3 到 6 个月，2027 年 1 月起。

requirements.text: 人力资源管理、心理学、工商管理或相近专业在读。
为他人安排过面试、会议或预约（例如候选人、被试）。
用招聘系统（ATS）或表格管理过候选人或应聘者信息。
写过招聘文案、公众号推文或其他对外文案。
按保密或个人信息保护要求处理过个人信息。
每周可实习 4 天及以上。
